title: Meals in Our Family
text:
Every morning I eat bread with butter and drink a cup of tea. At lunch I eat soup and rice at school. In the evening my family eats dinner together. We have fish on Fridays.

My favourite meal is breakfast because I am always hungry. My brother likes sweet cakes. He eats a cake after dinner. Our grandmother makes the best soup in the family.

questions.text: What does the writer drink in the morning?
What does the brother like to eat?
What can we guess about the family's evening meals?
options: They are usually rushed and quick
They are a time when the family is together
They are eaten alone in each room

questions.text: Who is probably a good cook in the family?

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
the main meal of the day, often eaten in the evening
a hot liquid food made from vegetables, meat or fish
the mother of a person's father or mother

paragraph_translations: Każdego ranka jem chleb z masłem i piję filiżankę herbaty. W porze lunchu jem zupę i ryż w szkole. Wieczorem moja rodzina je obiad razem. W piątki jemy rybę.
Moim ulubionym posiłkiem jest śniadanie, bo zawsze jestem głodny. Mój brat lubi słodkie ciastka. Je ciastko po obiedzie. Nasza babcia robi najlepszą zupę w rodzinie.
